title: The Sibylline Oracles
author: Milton S. Terry (trans)
description: Milton S. Terry presents prophetic writings attributed to the Sibyls and shaped by Jewish and Christian authors. The collection uses the voice of ancient prophecy to explore history, judgement and religious hope.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/sibyllineoracles00terruoft).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
